watch_list.summary: Running it creates a skill such as /verify-notifications with a formal spec of the properties that must hold, then model-checks possible states.
Use /statechart to visually confirm the generated model matches what the product should do, since only you know that.
Formal checks run in code instead of through the agent, so you pay once to create the skill and save tokens over time.
She uses this on end-to-end flows she needs to prove work, including a Grok Bot bug that spammed phone notifications while someone was already on desktop.
If you forget which skills fit a task, try /poteto-help and ask which ones would help.
